overall_goal: Return the plant-based burger to the sauce and cook it

goals.description: Transfer the plant-based burger to the frying pan and mix it with the sauce
goals.rationale: The person uses a spatula to move the plant-based burger from a plate into the pan, puts the plate away, and stirs the burger into the sauce.

goals.description: Cook and periodically stir the food in the pan
goals.rationale: The person stirs the food multiple times and adjusts the hob heat to ensure the meal cooks properly.
